description: A dark-haired young man in a white shirt and dark waistcoat lies slumped and asleep in a red velvet armchair beside a table with a lit candle, a small bottle of red liquid and scattered papers. Above him a pale ghostly woman in a long white gown drifts through swirling smoke, and behind her dark horned and winged figures and dancing wraiths fill a shadowy, painterly background. Oil-painting style, edge to edge, no visible text or frame.
